descriptor: An AI-driven real estate opportunity engine that analyzes properties to provide investors with actionable insights and automation tools.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to select a city, ZIP code, neighborhood, or investment strategy for property analysis.
The system must continuously analyze properties and assign an Opportunity Score from 0–100.
The system must provide an AI Assessment for each property, detailing potential acquisition strategies.
The system must generate a recommended action for each property based on its Opportunity Score.
The system must create an AI workspace for properties when a user selects 'Work This Deal'.
The system must include a Research Agent to gather property history, comparable properties, and neighborhood trends.
The system must include a Deal Analyst to calculate ARV, rehab assumptions, and potential returns.
The system must include an Outreach Agent to generate communication materials for contacting property owners.
The system must include a Negotiation Agent to suggest offers and negotiation strategies.
The system must include a Due Diligence Agent to create inspection checklists and identify potential issues.
The system must include a Disposition Agent to suggest strategies for wholesaling, renting, or flipping properties.
The system must provide a 'Why Now?' explanation for each property to justify its current opportunity status.
The system must allow users to view a 'Top 20 Opportunities This Week' list based on their input criteria.
The system must support image recognition to identify properties from user-uploaded photos.
The system must flag uncertain opportunities for human review.
The system must provide a clear rationale for decisions made in property recommendations.
The system must monetize through investor subscriptions and transaction-based fees.
The system must allow users to purchase detailed Opportunity Reports for individual properties.

stories.title: User selects location and receives Opportunity Score
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want to select a location and receive an Opportunity Score, so that I can identify potential properties.
acceptance: Given a user selects a city, when the system analyzes properties, then it displays an Opportunity Score.
Given a user selects a ZIP code, when no properties are found, then it displays a 'No opportunities' message.
Trust: The system logs the analysis process for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement location selection UI and integrate with property analysis backend.

stories.title: AI Assessment and recommended action for properties
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want an AI Assessment and recommended action for properties, so that I can decide on next steps.
acceptance: Given a property with a high Opportunity Score, when viewed, then it shows an AI Assessment and recommended action.
Given a property with a low Opportunity Score, when viewed, then it shows a minimal assessment.
Trust: The system logs the rationale for the recommended action.
stories.task_guidance: Develop AI Assessment logic and integrate with property details view.

stories.title: Create AI workspace for selected property
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want to create an AI workspace for a property, so that I can manage its analysis and actions.
acceptance: Given a user selects 'Work This Deal', when confirmed, then an AI workspace is created.
Given a workspace creation failure, when retried, then it succeeds or provides an error message.
Trust: The system logs workspace creation events.
stories.task_guidance: Design AI workspace structure and integrate with property selection.

stories.title: Research Agent gathers property data
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want the Research Agent to gather property data, so that I have comprehensive information for decision-making.
acceptance: Given a property in a workspace, when analyzed, then the Research Agent provides property history and trends.
Given missing data sources, when attempted, then it logs an error and continues.
Trust: The system logs all data retrieval actions.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data retrieval for property history and trends.

stories.title: Deal Analyst calculates property returns
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want the Deal Analyst to calculate property returns, so that I can evaluate investment potential.
acceptance: Given a property in a workspace, when analyzed, then the Deal Analyst provides ARV and potential returns.
Given calculation errors, when detected, then it logs the issue and retries.
Trust: The system logs all calculation processes.
stories.task_guidance: Develop calculation logic for ARV and investment returns.

stories.title: Outreach Agent generates communication materials
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want the Outreach Agent to generate communication materials, so that I can contact property owners effectively.
acceptance: Given a property in a workspace, when prompted, then the Outreach Agent generates a homeowner letter and email.
Given a communication failure, when detected, then it logs the issue and retries.
Trust: The system logs all communication generation actions.
stories.task_guidance: Implement templates for letters and emails, integrate with property data.

stories.title: Negotiation Agent suggests offers
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want the Negotiation Agent to suggest offers, so that I can negotiate effectively with property owners.
acceptance: Given a property in a workspace, when analyzed, then the Negotiation Agent suggests an initial and maximum offer.
Given a suggestion error, when detected, then it logs the issue and retries.
Trust: The system logs all offer suggestion actions.
stories.task_guidance: Develop logic for offer suggestions based on property data.

stories.title: Opportunity Feed displays top opportunities
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want to view the 'Top 20 Opportunities This Week', so that I can quickly identify potential investments.
acceptance: Given user criteria, when processed, then the system displays the top 20 opportunities.
Given no matching opportunities, when processed, then it displays a 'No opportunities' message.
Trust: The system logs the criteria and results for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement opportunity feed UI and integrate with scoring logic.

stories.title: Image recognition identifies properties from photos
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want to identify properties from photos, so that I can assess opportunities on-the-go.
acceptance: Given a user-uploaded photo, when processed, then the system identifies the property and displays details.
Given an unrecognized photo, when processed, then it displays an error message.
Trust: The system logs all image recognition attempts.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate image recognition API and connect to property database.

stories.title: Flag uncertain opportunities for review
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want uncertain opportunities flagged for review, so that I can ensure decision accuracy.
acceptance: Given an uncertain opportunity, when detected, then the system flags it for review.
Given a flagging error, when detected, then it logs the issue and retries.
Trust: The system logs all flagging actions for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement uncertainty detection logic and flagging mechanism.

stories.title: User purchases detailed Opportunity Report
stories.narrative: As an investor, I want to purchase detailed Opportunity Reports, so that I can access in-depth property analysis.
acceptance: Given a user selects a property, when purchasing a report, then the system provides the detailed report.
Given a purchase failure, when detected, then it logs the issue and retries.
Trust: The system logs all purchase transactions for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop purchase flow and integrate with payment gateway.

stories.title: Due Diligence Agent creates inspection checklists
stories.narrative: As a property analyst, I want a Due Diligence Agent to create inspection checklists, so that I can identify potential issues with properties.
acceptance: Given a property is selected, When the Due Diligence Agent is activated, Then it creates an inspection checklist for the property.
Given a property with known issues, When the Due Diligence Agent reviews it, Then it identifies potential issues.
Trust: The system logs the checklist creation and identified issues for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement the Due Diligence Agent to generate checklists based on property data. Ensure it logs all actions in the audit trail.

stories.title: Disposition Agent suggests property strategies
stories.narrative: As a property investor, I want a Disposition Agent to suggest strategies for properties, so that I can decide whether to wholesale, rent, or flip them.
acceptance: Given a property is selected, When the Disposition Agent is activated, Then it suggests strategies for wholesaling, renting, or flipping.
Given a property with specific market conditions, When the Disposition Agent analyzes it, Then it suggests the most viable strategy.
Trust: The system logs the strategy suggestions and rationale for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the Disposition Agent to analyze property data and suggest strategies. Ensure all suggestions and rationales are logged.

stories.title: Provide 'Why Now?' explanation for properties
stories.narrative: As a property analyst, I want the system to provide a 'Why Now?' explanation for each property, so that I can understand its current opportunity status.
acceptance: Given a property is selected, When the analysis is complete, Then the system provides a 'Why Now?' explanation.
Given a property with fluctuating market conditions, When the analysis is conducted, Then the explanation reflects current conditions.
Trust: The system logs the 'Why Now?' explanation and supporting data for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Enhance the Opportunity Analysis Module to generate 'Why Now?' explanations based on current market data. Ensure explanations are logged.

stories.title: Provide rationale for property recommendations
stories.narrative: As a property investor, I want the system to provide a clear rationale for property recommendations, so that I can trust the decision-making process.
acceptance: Given a property recommendation is made, When the user requests details, Then the system provides a clear rationale.
Given a recommendation with multiple factors, When the user reviews it, Then the rationale includes all relevant factors.
Trust: The system logs the rationale and decision-making process for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Update the Recommendation Engine to include detailed rationales for each recommendation. Ensure all rationales are logged for audit.
